messages:
andrew: FYI running a quick reconciliation check for BlueForge (on-prem HW partner) and were seeing ~1.8% usage mismatch for some customers. Looks like a mix of timezone offsets and granularity differences.

kelly: Can you share an example of the payload theyre sending?

andrew: Sample they sent: `{"event_id":"evt-9c4","batch_id":"b-20260319-12","timestamp":"2026-03-19T00:00:02-08:00","device_customer":"BF:CUST:acme-corp","core_seconds":120}`. We ingest into UTC hourly buckets and round to minutes -> some 2-second events get dropped into previous hour during PST->UTC rollovers.

nisha: Ah the offset in the timestamp is the culprit. We require ISO timestamps normalized to UTC in the contract. Also prefer cumulative counters to compute deltas.

carlos: Do BlueForge devices support cumulative totals (monotonic)? If yes we can compute deltas and avoid per-event rounding issues. If not, we need stricter bucket rules.

andrew: They currently only send per-event `core_seconds`. They can ship a `total_core_seconds` field next week if we ask. They do include `batch_id` and sometimes `seq` inside batch but not consistently.

kelly: Proposal for contract update: 1) require `event_id` (UUID), `customer_id` (marketplace account_id), `timestamp` in UTC, and one of `core_seconds` OR `total_core_seconds`. 2) If `total_core_seconds` present, server computes delta = total - last_total. 3) include `device_id` and `batch_id` for dedupe. 4) sign payload with `X-Marketplace-Signature: sha256=<hex>` HMAC header.

nisha: Add rules for resets: when `total_core_seconds` < last_total => treat as device reset; label event `reset:true` and start delta from 0, generate a RESET annotation in reconciliation.

andrew: Reconciliation window logic: keep a 2h late arrival window. If event belongs to previous window but within 15 minutes of boundary, assign to that window. Otherwise flag as late and include in monthly adjustment run.

carlos: Dedupe rules: prefer `event_id` if present; else `batch_id+device_id+sequence` fallback. We should keep event_id TTL 120 days.

kelly: Example JS HMAC verification snippet to include in contract docs:
```js
const crypto = require('crypto');
function verify(body, headerSig, secret) {
  const h = crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(body).digest('hex');
  return headerSig === `sha256=${h}`;
}
```

nisha: Tests to add in `contracts/blueforge/tests/`: out-of-order timestamps, duplicate `batch_id`, device reset, late batched upload (4h), timestamp with non-UTC offset. Include synthetic customer mapping where `device_customer` -> marketplace `account_id`.

andrew: Mapping note: BlueForge uses `device_customer` strings like `BF:CUST:<external_id>`. We need a signed mapping table published to them or an API they call to resolve to `account_id`. Prefer they send `account_id` directly to avoid reconciliation joins.

carlos: For reconciliation reports, surface columns: account_id, device_id, bucket_start_utc, raw_event_count, raw_core_seconds, computed_core_seconds, billed_core_seconds, late_flag, reset_flag, source_batch_id. We should surface % drift per-account and trigger ops alert if >1% for >3 consecutive days.

kelly: Ops alerting: add a daily drift digest and an immediate PagerDuty trigger for >5% drift for any enterprise account.

andrew: Action items: I will send a contract email to BlueForge with the schema + HMAC example by EOD. nisha you pick up tests, carlos please add the reconciliation report template to the console.

nisha: Will add tests and a tiny generator for synthetic sequences (out-of-order + resets). Will open PR to `contracts/blueforge/schema.json`.

carlos: Ill add the console drilldown and alert thresholds; will also add a metric exporter so partners can view mapping success rate.

ops-bot: Reminder: `marketplace-contracts` review meeting scheduled 2026-03-21 09:30 UTC (invite sent).

kelly: Thanks all. Once BlueForge confirms `total_core_seconds` we can flip ingestion to monotonic-delta mode and run a backfill reconciliation for the last 30 days.

andrew: Will loop Legal if they require SLA updates. Closing out here when contract ack received. :white_check_mark:
